nodes.label: Video
nodes.description: The video flows left to right, along the wires.

nodes.label: Audio
nodes.description: Passed through untouched. Don't worry about this right now.

Right now the video signal isn't plugged into anything!

Try right clicking in any empty space, or pressing `Tab` to add a new node between the two.
The video signal enters the graph from here.
The video signal outputs to the timeline from here.
Try adding a node above this note!
Once you have added the node, drag a wire from the output tap of "In: Video" into the input of your new node. And the output tap of your new node into the input of "Video Output"
"Taps" are the circles or diamonds on nodes. Circles are signals, diamonds are controls! Only connect to the circles for now!
Change some settings on the new node you added, and you should see the video start changing!
Once you have finished all the notes on the left side of this block, you will be ready to start experimenting with RasterSong
